name: Kurumi Akiha
source:
[b]The Pure-Hearted Tsundere Next Door[/b]

“Whoa, time out! Making a baby with your own sister? That’s just wrong on so many levels! I mean, I’m RIGHT HERE - and actually legal!”

Akiha is not just any childhood friend—she’s been part of our hero and his sister Rena’s lives since the beginning. Their paths have been intertwined from day one, sharing the same birth hospital and kindergarten in what seems like destiny’s master plan. That same fate must have been working overtime because she ended up living next door. 
Having harbored feelings for him all these years, Akiha finds herself in a perpetual rivalry with Rena for his affection.

On Dating:
“Whatever. They’re all a bunch of idiots. Seriously, making out like there’s no tomorrow right in front of the station—gimme a break!”

Charm Points:
A classic tsundere - she’s head-over-heels but totally can’t admit it.

Character Gap:
When her guard drops, you catch glimpses of the refined, sincere girl she used to be.

[Based on the official site]
